brief: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site: menu with prices, hours, location, pre-order. The farm section should show a map of our three farms, but we'll send the farm coordinates next week. Don't use any photos, but it must still feel warm.
outcome: Done: Identity confirmed every done-when item holds, with Audit's evidence. Open inputs for the Requester (not blocking): Menu items and their prices; Opening hours; Street address and phone number; Where pre-orders are sent (phone, WhatsApp, email or other); Coordinates and names of the three farms (promised next week).

done_when.criterion: The file is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, and needs no build step.
The page shows the name Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
A menu section lists items with a price slot for each; any price not supplied is marked as a placeholder.
An hours section is present; any hours not supplied are marked as a placeholder.
A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a marked placeholder for the street address.
A pre-order section has a form with fields for name, item, quantity and pickup time, and a marked placeholder for where orders are sent.
A farm section contains a map container with three farm entries in one labelled data block, each marked as awaiting coordinates, and no invented coordinates.
The file contains no img elements and no photo file or photo URL references.
A warm palette is defined (for example as CSS variables) and used across the page, with at least one non-photo decorative element such as SVG or CSS art.
The page includes a viewport meta tag and a responsive layout rule for narrow screens.
Every placeholder is visibly marked on the page and listed in a single comment block in the file.

route_check_violations.detail: picked no one, routed to Coordination
